mapper.sql: xzqhdm, xzqhmc, jjbh, jjdwdm, jjdwmc, glzjjdbh, jjlx, jqlyfs, lhlx, jjlyh, jjybh, jjyxm, bjsj, jjsj, jjwcsj, bjdh, bjdhyhm, bjdhyhdz, bjrxm, bjrxbdm, lxdh, bjrzjdm, bjrzjhm, bjdz, jqdz, bjnr, jcjxtjsdwdm, jcjxtjsdwmc, gxdwdm, gxdwmc, jqlbdm, jqlxdm, jqxldm, jqzldm, shlddwdm, tzdbh, zars, ywcwq, ywwxwz, ywbzxl, bkryqksm, ssryqksm, swryqksm, sfswybj, bjrdwxzb, bjrdwyzb, fxdwxzb, fxdwyzb, bcjjnr, jqdjdm, jqclztdm, yjjydjdm, sjchpzldm, sjcph, sfswhcl, rksj, gxsj, jqbq, sfbm, bjjjdbm, bjglzjjdbm, mrsjc, pt
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(bjrdwxzb, fxdwxzb) AS lng, COALESCE(bjrdwyzb, fxdwyzb) AS lat, jjbh, xzqhmc, jjlx, jqlbdm, jqlxdm, jqdz, bjnr, jjsj FROM jqhj_jjdb WHERE COALESCE(bjrdwxzb, fxdwxzb) IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(bjrdwyzb, fxdwyzb) IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(bjrdwxzb, fxdwxzb) BETWEEN #{minLng} AND #{maxLng} AND COALESCE(bjrdwyzb, fxdwyzb) BETWEEN #{minLat} AND #{maxLat} AND NOT (COALESCE(bjrdwxzb, fxdwxzb) = 0 AND COALESCE(bjrdwyzb, fxdwyzb) = 0) AND xzqhdm LIKE CONCAT(#{xzqhdm}, '%') ORDER BY jjsj DESC LIMIT 1000
